The '''Zardossa Stix Pyramid''' was a [[pyramid]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zardossa Stix/Legends|Zardossa Stix]] that was used during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] in her plan to finish the [[Frangawl sacrificial ceremony/Legends|ritual]] which would drain [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] from [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] into the [[Bardottan Sphere|living sphere]]. Julia's combined energy of the fallen [[Dagoyan Masters/Legends|Dagoyan Masters]] was to then be transferred to Talzin. As Julia's beloved [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] came to liberate Julia, they were hindered by the [[Stone guardian/Legends|stone guardians]] defending the temple but were able to defeat them, then went to rescue Julia. Shortly before the ritual could be completed by the sun's rays, Binks saved the queen, while Windu fought against Talzin. The wrong sacrifice was given in the form of the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] [[Peteen/Legends|leader]], causing the sphere with the trapped Force essence to explode. The three escaped while Talzin disappeared in a cloud of [[Color/Legends|green]] mist.
